body.x: GAZELAB, (CEO Lee Ju-Yeon), participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. for total of four days from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan.(local time) and introduced Gazedesk work station and GiiroMat and so on.

‘BEST OF MIK(MADE IN KOREA) CES TOP10’ selected only 10 companies among CES 2018 domestic exhibitors by global news network, Aving news and foreign news reporters from USA, China and other countries considering technological trend and growth potential of the companies. Each media will make a final evaluation during the CES exhibition and select the TOP3 for official announcement.

GAZELLAB is a spin-off company of concept store ‘GAZESHOP’ that introduces various smart gadgets and people can experience it, and is a research institute which rages from direct planning to development and design of IoT devices and mobile web service.
(Picture description: ‘GAZEDESK WORKSTATION’ which can be put on a desk and used easily)
In 2016, the world’s largest crowdfunding website ‘Kickstarter’, smart standing desk ‘GAZEDESK’ was revealed and received attention from foreign press.

This GAZEDESK Workstation, an upgraded version of the existing ‘GAZEDESK Smart duo’ model, can be easily put on a desk in use, and is intuitive and efficient since the height of its monitor and keyboard can be adjusted with a touch controller.

GiiroMat measures user’s attitude with a built-in pressure sensor and induces the user’s right posture by informing the user through the robot linked to an application whenever the user loses his/her posture.

On the other hand, CES, the largest IT exhibition in the world, is held every January as sponsored by the American Consumer Technology Association(CTA), an exhibition to be able to understand the trends of the tech and consumer electronics industry of the world at one sight.

Aving News, which has the most reported issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, the world’s top three tech exhibition for the last 11 years, dispatches special news reporters to CES this year as well, report major issues in the world market and introduces Korea’s major companies all over the world.
